mainText: Die wichtigsten KI-Meldungen: Anthropic: Neuere Claude-Modelle merken sich weniger und erreichen mehr – zum Beispiel in Pokémon. Anthropic hat untersucht, wie Claude sich über Sitzungen hinweg Wissen merken kann. (The Decoder.) Freshworks alums raise $53M to take on Salesforce, HubSpot with AI-native CRM. Aus der Tech-Welt: Chatbot als Arzt: Apple erforscht Health AI. In den USA können iPhone-Nutzer mit einer Apple-KI-App ihre Körperdaten teilen und über Gesundheitsthemen chatten. (heise online.) Operator-led VC firm Plural has raised €1 billion in new capital ($1.1 billion), joining a growing cohort of larger European funds that also includes Mundi … (TechCrunch.)

Neues aus der Szene: 10 essential Juan Atkins tracks that set techno in motion. Few artists have altered the course of music quite like Juan Atkins. (DJ Mag.) New music discovery website lets you scroll through over 70,000 DJ sets. 58 different channels feature on The Selector, with almost 2,000 Mixmag sets available to watch (Mixmag.) New book, Transients, explores how electronic music has been shaped by technology and time. Author David Reid drew on three decades of experience in the music industry to write the book (DJ Mag.)
